antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 670nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in odontoblast if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2024) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Resonance water-lipid: 306 THz (980nm) targeting membrane fluidity, 10^-14s pulses targeting cytochrome_c in odontoblast. Study reference: 2024 peer-reviewed paper shows electron transport +12% at 670nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial complex_I_NADH activation.
